title: 'Mandaadi' BO day 3 vs 'Sardar 2'
description: On its first Saturday, Mandaadi's box office earnings skyrocketed, achieving over nine crore rupees in India net just on its third day. This surge highlights a dramatic increase from its initial weekend earnings. Meanwhile, Karthi's 'Sardar 2' saw a minor dip in its Saturday performance. Mandaadi's overall gross worldwide collection is now nearing thirty crore rupees.

title: 'Haiwaan' Day 2: Akshay Kumar, Saif Ali Khan film earns Rs 2.50 cr
description: Haiwaan's India net collection fell to Rs 2.50 crore on Saturday. The film's overall occupancy improved to 14.0% from 11.0% on Friday. After two days, the movie has earned Rs 5.50 crore in India net. Its worldwide gross collection has now reached Rs 8.60 crore. Saif Ali Khan and Akshay Kumar reunite after eighteen years in this thriller.

title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' crosses Rs 245 crore globally in 9 days
description: 'Mirzapur The Movie' has comfortably crossed the Rs. 150 crore mark in India as it enters Day 9, with its net collection now standing at Rs. 159.63 crore. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer has settled into a slower but steady second-week pace, even as the film's overall worldwide tally pushes well past Rs. 225 crore. With the Rs. 150 crore milestone now behind it, attention has shifted to how much further the crime drama can stretch its theatrical run in the coming days.

title: 'Im Game' BO day 10 vs 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit'
description: Dulquer Salmaan's 'Im Game' saw a slight recovery on its tenth day of release. Nivin Pauly's 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit' gained significant momentum on its twenty-third day. The Malayalam version of 'Im Game' leads its language-wise earnings.

title: Haiwaan: Akshay, Saif film’s worldwide gross climbs to Rs 8.60 crore in 2 days
description: 'Haiwaan', the Priyadarshan-directed crime thriller starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, has opened to a modest response at the box office, entering Day 2 with its overall net collection still under Rs. 4 crore. The film, a remake of Priyadarshan's own Malayalam hit 'Oppam', now faces the challenge of building momentum through its first weekend as it competes for screen space and audience attention against other major releases currently running in theatres.

title: Kylie sells Hidden Hills mansion for $15.3m after listing it for $20.25m
description: Reality TV star and fashion mogul Kylie Jenner has sold her 13,200-square-foot Hidden Hills mansion for $15.3 million after listing it for $20.25 million. She purchased the sprawling California property for $12.05 million in 2016, aged 19. The lavish 1.4-acre estate features eight bedrooms, eight bathrooms, a pool, spa, home theatre and multiple entertainment spaces.
